g.text: I'm a fullstack developer from Mexico who modernizes and
automates the way teams work. I research a problem until I
understand its whole context, then build it on an architecture
made to scale, to be maintained and to last.
Most of my work lives on the web and the backend; on the side, I
build Android apps for problems of my own.
